COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Apr-19-2010 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This matter comes on calendar this day, having been assigned from the Presiding Judge Dept. 206 for Court Trial/Prove-Up Hearing. Comm: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, Reporter: Lois Jones, CSR #3689.

Jerome M. Yalon, Jr., Esq. appeared for plaintiff Beneficial California.
No appearance by defendant Caron P. Webster.
Notice of Time and Place of Trial was filed on December 23, 2009.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of plaintiff Beneficial California, and against defendant Caron P. Webster as follows:

Principal - $7,490.76.
Prejudgment Interest - $1,760.86.
Attorney Fees - $1,470.00.
Costs - $260.00.

Total - $10,981.62.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
